description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2022: Large-Scale Mobile Shakers and Associated Instrumentation for Dynamic Field Studies of Geotechnical and Structural Systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Kenneth Stokoe, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). NHERI@UTexas submitted a poster to the NHERI summit, explaining the capabilities and features of the facility. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-cdja-s865. Keywords: Experimental Facility with Large, Mobile Dynamic Shakers for Field Testing, Large-Scale Mobile Shakers. Published 2023-04-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
